messages:
Marta: Quick check-in  we need a tight copy pass for Hosted / Dedicated / Private hero headers before the webinar push. Focus: clearer CTAs + explicit lead routing. Who can take variants?
Ben: Ill run 3 headline angles per page: fast onboarding, predictable economics, and security-first.
Kim: routing note  separate lists in HubSpot: hosted_trial, dedicated_inquiry, private_sales. webinar signups go to webinar_list. add utm_campaign=hero_push_apr2026.
Ava: Drafts (short):
Hosted: "Start building with a production-ready hosted inference API"
Dedicated: "Reserved GPU capacity for predictable throughput"
Private: "Private deployments with VPC & KMS controls"
Marta: Good. CTAs: Hosted=Start free trial, Dedicated=Request capacity, Private=Contact sales. Dedicated form should ask qps & monthly tokens.
Ben: experiment plan: run 3x3 variants (angle x product) for 72h, then top winners for 5 days. track CTR, form submits, qualified leads.
Kim: Ill create lists + webhook mappings. will add small privacy microcopy under each CTA.
DeployBot: staging links created: https://staging.rwd/track/hostA, /dedB, /pvtC. Webhooks scheduled Thu 08:00 PT.
Marta: Timeline: copy drafts by Tue noon, staging Wed, launch Thu. Keep language specific, avoid vague superlatives.
Ava: Posting tone variants now.
Ben: :thumbsup:
